title: Gradual deploy sparklines — interactive playbook & onboarding cards
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, interactive onboarding asset pack that teaches engineers and PMs how gradual rollouts and version pinning behave under different traffic patterns. Focus is on a) sparklines and confidence bands that show latency/error drift during canary/A-B experiments, b) an editable fallback policy card with toggles for fallback triggers and thresholds, and c) a stepper-style quickstart carousel used in the product tour and docs. Deliverables: Figma prototype, 3x PNG hero screenshots at 1440/1024/480 widths, Lottie animation for the rollout sparkline, and localized microcopy for EN/FR/DE.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates interactive sparklines that animate at 30fps and respond to simulated traffic knobs
Fallback policy card allows editing of threshold values and shows instantaneous preview of traffic routing impact
Three responsive screenshot variants exported and approved for use in docs and in-app quickstart
Accessible color tokens used (WCAG AA) and contrast verified for sparklines and policy chips
Handoff checklist created with tokens, spacing, and export assets; dev notes for animation timing provided
dev_notes: Animation: sparkline uses 4s loop with eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); provide frame JSON for Lottie fallback
Data model: prototype simulates 3 metrics — latency p95, error rate, and traffic percentage by variant
Accessibility: provide aria-live updates for the stepper; ensure sparkline has data labels exposed for screen readers
Integration: product should accept JSON policy payload with fields: trigger_metric, threshold, cool_down_seconds, fallback_variant
